messages:
kiran: hey team — customers are seeing a spike of 5xxs and p95 timeouts on hosted inference for a few tenants since 09:12 UTC. dashboard shows request-queue depth hitting the 1024 hard limit and continuous-batcher backlog climbing. :warning:

kiran: example error from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z gateway host=gw-12 req_id=abcd1234 status=504 queue_depth=1024 route=hosted-gen model=redwood-large seq_len=512
2026-03-17T09:12:35Z batcher host=cb-7 backlog=87 kvspin=true
```

support: alert triggered: hosted-gateway-queue-deep (auto-post). paging oncall SRE. :rotating_light:

alice: @kiran can you paste a repro curl for the failing request? need headers and tenant id to correlate logs. :eyes:

kiran: repro curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx" \n  -H "x-tenant-id: acme-prod" \n  -d '{"input":"translate long text...","max_tokens":1024}'
```

dan: early hypothesis: sudden bulk job from acme-prod triggered many long-seq requests causing continuous-batcher cold kvcache spinups + high sequence lengths => request queue saturates. noticed kvcache spin events in batcher logs. fallback paths currently overflow at queue_depth=1024 and we start rejecting/timeout.

dan: quick mitigation options:
- route acme-prod to a smaller model variant (reduce per-token cost / runtime)
- enable early_reject for tenant to drop very long seqs (per-runbook)
- temporarily raise queue depth for dedicated hosts (if safe)
- ask customer to pause bulk job

alice: will try routing override now — pushing policy to route acme-prod -> redwood-medium-1 and enable early_reject=true. posting command: 
```json
{ "tenant": "acme-prod", "route_override": "redwood-medium-1", "early_reject": true }
```

ops: applied routing override on edge-region-a. also throttled concurrent requests for acme-prod at the gateway to 16. monitoring effect. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: runbook link: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/queue-saturation — follow "bulk-tenant-spike" playbook (step 2: routing override, step 3: kvcache warm-up).

kiran: support pinged customer to pause the job, customer acknowledged and said they can hold for 30m.

alice: within 3m of override, observed backlog drop: continuous-batcher backlog from 87 -> 6, queue depth from 1024 -> 180. p95 for tenant fell from 12.4s -> 1.2s. still watching. :relieved:

dan: next actions:
- collect traces for a sample of timed-out requests and attach to the incident
- add a transient throttle guard for longseq requests across Gateway to avoid reoccurrence
- follow up with product on default queue depth limits and per-tenant safeguards

kiran: creating incident ticket INC-2026-1798 and will dump correlation traces + sample payloads. tagging SRE and Product.

support: closing customer-facing loop: sent update to acme support channel — they confirmed pause and will resubmit as chunked batches.

alice: marking this thread resolved for the immediate outage. leaving monitoring for 45m. will update incident once traces attached. :white_check_mark:
